name: Full-stack framework with Copilot playbook and dev-helper tools

mentions.name: Full-stack framework with Copilot playbook and dev-helper tools
mentions.description: This full-stack framework (frontend and backend) pairs with a playbook for Copilot to follow, focusing AI-assisted development work so generated code stops being slop. It includes a schema-UI system, data-aware UI components, the basis of low-code tools, and a nearly finished local LLM that runs tests and fixes code to save tokens.
mentions.problem: AI-generated code hits multiple problems and has to be reworked like junior dev code without a framework focusing the work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
the framework. Aside from the product itself, I've ended up with a really nice framework (FE and BE) and playbook for copilot to follow. I've hit multiple problems with AI generated code and had to rework it like I have for junior devs! But now, the framework focuses the work and stops the slop!

I want to build out all the product-dev-helper tools I've wanted in the past. I've already got a lovely schema-UI system, UI components which are data-aware and the basis of some low-ish-code tools. I've also nearly got a "run tests and fix" local LLM which saves tokens.
